{{Quote|We are poised on the edge of a brillian new era. Tomorrow we open a new chapter in Esseles' history, a return to her glorious days of empire and sector dominance.|[[Jamson Freller]]|<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
The '''Esselian Hall election of [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]''' saw the victory of [[Jamson Freller]]'s pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Esselian New Order Party|New Order Party]] at the [[Esseles/Legends|Esselian]] [[Esselian Hall|Hall]]. Esselian [[President/Legends|President]] [[Cambira Ralle]]'s [[Forad Party]] lost its grip on the majority for the first time in over two decades.
